dedupe_keys.name: catalogo oficial de datos y servicios inspire port and maritime datasets

description: Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. Coverage: Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Dominio Público Marítimo Terrestre (Núcleos excluidos); Límites Marítimos del Reino de España (INSPIRE); Zonas de servicio portuarias de España; Zonas de alto potencial para la actividad portuaria. Formats seen: XML, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
